definitions.explanation: The annual income from an investment expressed as a percentage of its cost or current value. Used in finance for bonds, stocks, real estate, and other investments.

examples.japanese: {利回|りまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{債券|さいけん}→債券：15636_saiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利回|りまわ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧3%だ。
examples.english: The yield on this bond is 3% per year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧{利回|りまわ}り⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦{実質|じっしつ}→実質：12282_jisshitsu⟧{利回|りまわ}り⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: In real estate investment, you should check not only the gross yield but also the net yield.

notes: A key term in finance and investing. Common collocations: {利回|りまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (high/low yield), ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧{利回|りまわ}り (gross yield), ⟦{実質|じっしつ}→実質：12282_jisshitsu⟧{利回|りまわ}り (net yield), ⟦{配当|はいとう}→配当：05970_haitou⟧{利回|りまわ}り (dividend yield). Compound structure: ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (profit, interest) + ⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (rotation, return). Related: ⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧ (interest rate — for loans/deposits), ⟦{収益率|しゅうえきりつ}→収益率：24110_shuuekiritsu⟧ (rate of return — more formal).
